id: title:Piccirello:catch untriaged bucket settings in ci

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a registry of ClickHouse bucket-setting names to support warehouse backend checks, but the tier is established conservatively at 1 because the actual implementation of the URL pattern validation and warehouse backend changes is missing from this chunk, preventing assessment of the complete systemic capability.
review.reason: Adds a registry of Django settings naming buckets that ClickHouse can read without credentials, and a registry of settings not readable by the ClickHouse node role. review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks the implementation of the warehouse backend and warehouse source connector changes, and the updated warehouse table URL pattern validation. Therefore, while the registry is a necessary component, its complete tier cannot be established without the implementation. This chunk is a dependency, not the complete capability.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new bucket-setting checks, the updated warehouse table URL pattern validation, or the complete set of warehouse backend and warehouse source connector changes. It only includes the added bucket-setting registry and the corresponding unit tests. Without the implementation, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a registry of Django settings naming buckets that ClickHouse can read without credentials, and a registry of settings not readable by the ClickHouse node role.
observations.posthog_connection: These settings are used to prevent warehouse tables from pointing at PostHog-owned storage, which could allow cross-tenant access or expose internal data. The registry is used to check warehouse table URL patterns against PostHog-owned buckets.
